maddeler.e:
نتدافع (form VI)
# نَتَدَافَعُ (natadāfaʕu) /na.ta.daː.fa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# نُتَدَافَعُ (nutadāfaʕu) /nu.ta.daː.fa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# نَتَدَافَعَ (natadāfaʕa) /na.ta.daː.fa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# نُتَدَافَعَ (nutadāfaʕa) /nu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
